question: Who unveiled the equestrian statue of Chhatrapati Shivaji in Gandhinagar, Gujarat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Home Minister Amit Shah.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation, Shri Amit Shah today unveiled the equestrian statue of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj constructed by Maharashtra Samaj Gandhinagar in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The equestrian statue of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj was unveiled in Gandhinagar, Gujarat by Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation, Shri Amit Shah.**
 
• The statue was constructed by Maharashtra Samaj Gandhinagar.
 
• The event was held in Gandhinagar, the capital city of Gujarat.
 
• Deputy Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri Harsh Sanghavi, and other dignitaries were present on the occasion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Equestrian Statue__

 __
 
• A statue that depicts a figure mounted on a horse, often used to honor historical warriors or leaders.
 
• Such statues symbolize leadership, power, and valor.
 
 
 
• Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj__
 
 
• A celebrated 17th century Indian warrior-king and founder of the Maratha Empire.
 
• Known for establishing ‘Hindavi Swaraj’ and his naval legacy.
